observations: Blue and black portable machine housing.

claims.claim: pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance
claims.evidence: Requires a video of the machine operating under load to verify performance.

risks.proof: Video of the machine spraying water at high pressure.

risks.risk: Missing high-pressure hose and spray wand
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories (hose, wand, nozzles) laid out.

risks.risk: Internal leaks or cracked pump housing
risks.proof: Video showing the machine running without water leaking from the casing.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the brand, model, and pressure rating.
Video of the machine connected to water and power, demonstrating it can reach and hold pressure.
Photo of the high-pressure hose and the complete spray wand assembly.
response.reason: The brand and model are not visible, and these are the primary factors in pricing a pressure washer. A worst-case price for an unidentified, unproven machine is too low to be useful without more data.
